713:t_012:2.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Naturally. This $$次元将$$ is the ultimate union of man and machine, made possible by the $$リヴァイヴ・セル$$.」

713:t_012:3.en:
$$レド$$
「So it's the ultimate form of artificial $$真化融合$$...!」

713:t_012:4.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Exactly. Unless you stake everything you have, it is impossible for you to fight me as an equal.」

713:t_012:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Time to end this! Farewell, warriors who let me glimpse an unreachable dream, if only for a moment!」

713:t_013:3.en:
$$セツコ$$
「That presence... I felt it before in the $$カオス・コスモス$$...」

713:t_013:4.en:
$$桂$$
「Then that's the $$御使い$$ of Sorrow!」

713:t_013:5.en:
???
「It is not only the $$次元将$$ who is sad...」

713:t_013:9.en:
???
「Those who cannot abandon conflict, and bring about their own ruin... All of it is sad...」

713:t_013:11.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Even so, we have decided to move forward!」

713:t_013:12.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Humans may be foolish creatures who can't stop fighting...」

713:t_013:13.en:
$$キラ$$
「But if we don't overcome that, there's surely something we'll never obtain...!」

713:t_013:14.en:
$$宗介$$
「That's what we fight for...! No, what we live for!」

713:t_013:15.en:
$$葵$$
「Living...! It's the instinct from which everything begins!」

713:t_013:16.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Within it, we meet... and mingle!」

713:t_013:17.en:
$$シモン$$
「And from there, we set out in search of something we have yet to see!」

713:t_013:18.en:
$$アムロ$$
「And then we build civilization, and try to find a future beyond the fighting!」

713:t_013:20.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Blood of the beast, mingling of waters, destination of the wind, civilization of fire...」

713:t_013:21.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「Even after halting in despair, they take the path to $$シンカ$$ again, one step at a time! And what awaits at its end is...」

713:t_014:0.en:
$$カヲル$$
「The time that had stopped has begun to move again...」

713:t_015:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Later, $$セツコ$$! Right now, the $$ヴィルダーク$$ in front of us comes first!」

713:t_015:2.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「So you've gained the power of $$真化融合$$ again...」

713:t_015:3.en:
$$甲児$$
「Sorry to keep you waiting, $$マジンガー$$! Let's make your light and mine one again!」

713:t_015:4.en:
$$バナージ$$
「$$ユニコーン$$! Now is the time to show the possibility you led me to!」

713:t_015:5.en:
$$赤木$$
「Let's do this, $$ダイ・ガード$$! A salaryman and a robot, side by side, protecting the peace!」

713:t_016:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「What a warrior needs is not pity! It's victory!」

713:t_016:1.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Couldn't agree more, $$ヴィルダーク$$!」

713:t_016:2.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Warriors who have achieved $$真化融合$$! Fighting you and defeating you was my wish as well!」

713:t_016:3.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「By defeating you, I will repay all the lives I have taken to make them into $$次元獣$$!」

713:t_016:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「...I knew. That our way of doing things was wrong.」

713:t_016:6.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「The $$次元獣ヴァルナー$$ that never reaches its final form... This must be proof of my hesitation.」

713:t_016:7.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Even so, I had no choice but to go through with it... I kept telling myself there was no other way. But it was all meaningless.」

713:t_016:8.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「All I can do, to repay their lives, is defeat you with this power...!」

713:t_016:11.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I can't stand to watch. A man who lost sight of what he should be doing for the sake of self-satisfaction.」

713:t_016:12.en:
$$刹那$$
「If you knew that what you were doing was a mistake, why didn't you try to change yourself!」

713:t_016:13.en:
$$レド$$
「Don't refuse to change! Not when there's a better way!」

713:t_016:14.en:
$$タケル$$
「Your greatest mistake is your arrogance, your refusal to change how you live!」

713:t_016:15.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Say what you will. This is all I am capable of.」

713:t_016:17.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Then I'll take you on! In whatever way satisfies you!」

713:t_016:18.en:
$$アマタ$$
「We can't afford to lose either!」

713:t_016:19.en:
$n
「Just as you can't accept our existence, we can't accept you, who have made Earth suffer!」

713:t_016:20.en:
$n
「I won't let a power like that open up the future!」

713:t_016:21.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Then come, warriors of Earth! The victor earns the right to challenge the $$御使い$$s!」

713:t_016:22.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I will devour you, take the four $$スフィア$$s, and gain the god-killing power!」

713:t_017:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「This is as far as I go...!」

713:t_017:2.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Needless to say... The victors are you...」

713:t_018:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I'm sorry, $$次元獣$$... I have no strength left to fight anymore...」

713:t_019:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I... couldn't atone for the lives I took...」

713:t_019:1.en:
$n
「The people who died aren't here anymore...」

713:t_019:2.en:
$n
「Atoning to those people matters too... But if you call yourself a general, you should have looked for what you could do for the people who are still alive.」

713:t_019:3.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「$$いがみ合う双子$$... Is that the answer you came up with, beyond both hope and despair...」

713:t_019:4.en:
$n
「...I don't know if it's an answer, though...」

713:t_019:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「$$いがみ合う双子$$... The $$悲しみの乙女$$, the $$傷だらけの獅子$$, the $$揺れる天秤$$...」

713:t_019:6.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Anyone will do. Take my four $$スフィア$$s. You who have achieved $$真化融合$$ should be able to.」

713:t_019:7.en:
$n
「...How am I supposed to do that to someone who's lost the will to fight...」

713:t_019:10.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I've been dealing with the $$次元将$$ since the days of the $$破界事変$$. This one's my job, I'd say.」

713:t_019:11.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「The $$揺れる天秤$$, huh... I thank you for your strong will.」

713:t_019:12.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Knock it off. I don't need to hear that from the guy whose life I'm about to take.」
